goal: Investigate model mismatch within a bounded thermal experiment budget.

revision_semantics.register_revision: Stage a provisional fitted candidate for testing, not acceptance or causal identification.
revision_semantics.confirmation: To test a fitted candidate: register_revision first, then propose_experiment on its returned model_id with kind confirmation.
revision_semantics.verdict: Only measured confirmation supports or rejects a staged revision on that tested input.

decision.rationale: Initial both-heated (initial-0), left-only (initial-1), and right-only (initial-2) trials available; need bounded numerical comparison of linear vs sensor_lag vs quadratic_loss before spending experiment budget.

Candidate fits show sensor_lag training RMSE 0.079 vs 0.42 for linear/quadratic_loss on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2, but training fit is not independent confirmation; propose diagnostic staggered test of initial model to seek measured mismatch within budget before staging any revision.
